sourceSummary: Walsall current 2026/27 identity selection cross-checked against the committed FootballSquads roster/DOB source, current signing/loan evidence and detailed current or last-published role/value records. Snapshot-date birthdays are normalized, broad identity groups are refined to SWOS roles, and unavailable published values are encoded as 0 rather than estimated.

Jenson Kilroy.notes: No published market value is available in the cited current evidence; 0 records unavailable evidence rather than an estimate.

Mason Hancock.notes: Detailed role evidence lists left-back, with centre-back and left midfield as alternatives.

Harrison Burke.notes: Age is normalized at the 2026-09-27 snapshot from the published 13/09/2002 date of birth; older cached pages still display 23.

Courtney Clarke.notes: The broad identity feed labels Clarke as a defender, but detailed current role evidence lists central midfield with defensive/right-midfield alternatives. The SWOS role is therefore midfield.

Sven Sprangler.notes: Current 2026/27 transfer evidence confirms Walsall membership. Detailed role is central midfield/defensive midfield; the player profile may be stale on club membership.

Charlie Crew.notes: Leeds confirms the 05/08/2026 season-long Walsall loan. Detailed role is defensive midfield with central midfield as an alternative.

Lewis Simper.notes: Age is normalized at the 2026-09-27 snapshot from the published 03/09/2001 date of birth. Current transfer evidence confirms the Walsall arrival and central-midfield role. No current published market value is available; 0 records unavailable evidence rather than an estimate.

Reece Smith.notes: Walsall's July 2026 signing is confirmed by current reporting. Detailed role evidence lists left winger; €150k is the published England C value.

Antony Evans.notes: Walsall's 01/09/2026 season-long loan is separately confirmed. Age is normalized at the snapshot from the published 23/09/1998 date of birth. The detailed profile is stale on club membership but supplies the attacking-midfield role and last published €400k value.

Tai Sodje.notes: BBC confirms the 17/07/2026 permanent Walsall signing. Age is normalized at the snapshot from the published 20/09/2003 date of birth. Detailed role is centre-forward with attacking midfield as an alternative. No published market value is available; 0 records unavailable evidence rather than an estimate.

Andrew Dallas.notes: Transfermarkt publishes this player as Andy Dallas. Age is normalized at the snapshot from the published 22/07/1999 date of birth; the footballName key remains matched to the committed identity feed.

Isaac Moore.notes: Current evidence confirms the 2026/27 Walsall loan from Coventry and central-midfield role. No published market value is shown in the cited evidence; 0 records unavailable evidence rather than an estimate.
